name: Release precompiled binaries

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - '[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  create-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      tag: ${{ steps.set-tag.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set tag
        id: set-tag
        run: echo "tag=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Validate Cargo.toml version
        run: |
          TAG=${{ steps.set-tag.outputs.tag }}
          VERSION=$(grep '^version' Cargo.toml | head -n1 | awk -F\" '{print $2}')
          if [ "$TAG" != "$VERSION" ]; then
            echo "Tag $TAG does not match Cargo.toml version $VERSION"
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Create draft release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.set-tag.outputs.tag }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  build-cli:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            name: linux-x86_64
            cuda: ''
            cross: false
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            name: linux-x86_64-cuda11_8
            cuda: '11.8'
            cross: false
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            name: linux-x86_64-cuda12_4
            cuda: '12.4'
            cross: false
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            name: linux-x86_64-cuda13_0
            cuda: '13.0'
            cross: false
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            name: linux-aarch64
            cuda: ''
            cross: true
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            name: macos-arm64
            cuda: ''
            cross: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          override: true
      - name: Install lld
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y lld
      - name: Install CUDA Toolkit
        if: matrix.cuda != ''
        uses: Jimver/cuda-toolkit@v0.2.0
        with:
          cuda: ${{ matrix.cuda }}
          method: network
      - name: Install cross
        if: matrix.cross
        run: cargo install cross --version 0.2.5
      - name: Build
        env:
          RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""
          CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_UNKNOWN_LINUX_GNU_LINKER: lld
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.cross }}" = "true" ]; then
            cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
          else
            cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
          fi
      - name: Package
        run: |
          BIN=target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/cake
          if [ ! -f "$BIN" ]; then
            echo "Binary not found: $BIN"
            exit 1
          fi
          tar -czf cake-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz -C target/${{ matrix.target }}/release cake
          sha256sum cake-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz > cake-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz.sha256
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cake-${{ matrix.name }}
          path: |
            cake-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz
            cake-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz.sha256

  build-mobile:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: aarch64-linux-android
            name: android-aarch64
            cross: true
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-ios
            name: ios-arm64
            cross: false

        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1

          toolchain: stable
